instruction: Find the couch, approach until the body touches it, and sit on the couch.
mediaNote: Chronological head-camera observations from this evaluation, displayed at two observations per second. This is not continuous action footage; playback time does not represent episode elapsed time. No interpolation or rerendering.
videoNote: Chronological head-camera observations from this evaluation, displayed at two observations per second. This is not continuous action footage; playback time does not represent episode elapsed time. No interpolation or rerendering.
timingNote: Trace timestamps use execution time; reported elapsed time also includes worker setup and cleanup. Observation playback has a separate clock.
callCoverage: Recorded native action events. Observation and helper calls are not enumerated; visible-state descriptions are supplied by the agent.

steps.title: Observe and decide
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# First cell: observe and yield to see the current state
p.observe()
print("Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the couch.")
steps.stdout: Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the couch.

steps.title: walk forward
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Walk forward towards the couch visible on the right
p.walk_forward(speed="slow", visible_state="Couch visible ahead on the right with patterned upholstery and red pillow")
print("Walking forward towards the couch.")

calls.name: walk_forward
calls.agentVisibleState: Couch visible ahead on the right with patterned upholstery and red pillow

steps.title: walk forward
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Walk forward to make contact with the couch
p.walk_forward(speed="slow", visible_state="Couch immediately to the right - about to make contact with patterned upholstery and red pillow")

steps.title: side step
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Side step right to ensure contact with the couch
p.side_step(direction="right", distance=0.15, visible_state="Couch immediately to the right - attempting to make physical contact")
print("Side stepping right to touch the couch.")
steps.stdout: Side stepping right to touch the couch.

calls.name: side_step
calls.agentVisibleState: Couch immediately to the right - attempting to make physical contact

steps.title: sit
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Sit on the couch - estimated seat height around 0.5m for a typical couch
p.sit(height=0.5, visible_state="Couch with patterned upholstery and red pillow - attempting to sit")
print("Sitting on the couch.")

calls.name: sit
calls.agentVisibleState: Couch with patterned upholstery and red pillow - attempting to sit

steps.title: stop
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Task completed - sitting on the couch. Stop to commit the pose.
p.stop(visible_state="Successfully sitting on the couch with patterned upholstery and red pillow visible")
print("Task completed. Stopping to commit the pose.")
